description: (Deprecated: use 'recommend' instead. Works identically.) Get a personalized skincare recommendation with ingredient-aware scoring and routine building. Use when the user wants advice, has a skin concern, or asks what to buy. Do not use for browsing or listing products — use search_products instead. Returns scored products with checkout URLs.

brand.description: Filter to a specific brand only (e.g. 'Glossier', 'CeraVe', 'The Ordinary'). Use when the user asks for products from a specific brand.

query.description: Natural language query about skin concerns (e.g. 'I have oily acne-prone skin, under $30')

strategy.description: Optional offer strategy override: starter, gentle, budget, glow_safe, minimal, strong, fallback
